name: optimize-store-listing
job: Optimize store listing: metadata, creatives, localization, conversion experiment, compliance, with exact-channel revisions.

inScope: Building positioning-to-asset narrative and metadata contract
Specifying creatives and stable production asset requests
Localization briefs per locale with native QA
Defining conversion experiments with countermetrics and stop rules
outOfScope: Public review solicitation and paid acquisition

inputs: Exact product/build/content identity and channel territories
Audience, positioning promise, conversion event, and price model
Current listing evidence and channel contracts
outputs: Channel Listing and Creative Sequence with exact revisions
Experiment design with metrics, confidence, stop, rollback, and readback

data: exact shipped behavior evidence for every claim
permissions: channel authority for publication only when selected

failureSemantics: Every live claim must be exact-build truthful, localized, and accessible; conversion gains that worsen downstream quality, trust, retention, refund, or support countermetrics are not wins; no second production source of truth is created.

outcome.observable: A Channel Listing and Creative Sequence where every claim maps to exact shipped behavior, assets pass channel QA by digest, localization is native-QA'd, and conversion gains survive trust and retention countermetrics with live readback.
